about: Settings for bin/watchdog.sh (D47), read by bin/watchdog_settings.py; check with `bin/watchdog_settings.py --check`. gateway: how the watchdog decides whether Stella's gateway is down, active, quiet or unknown. The process must exist (process_match, a pgrep -f pattern). The newest connection line (connected_marker / disconnected_marker, regexes) over all activity_logs decides a disconnect; a log written within activity_window_minutes counts as activity. A quiet log alone is never an alert. Log lines start with a timestamp in log_time_format and log_timezone ("owner" = the owner's zone, or an IANA name). pause_file: while it exists the gateway is not checked. test_rerun: when the test step fails, failed_check_line (one capture group = the check name) finds the failed checks in its output, failed_detail_line the first failing line; each failed check runs once more as rerun_command ({check}), and only a second failure alerts.

gateway.disconnected_marker: \[Discord\] Disconnected|Reconnect(ing)? discord|Fatal discord adapter error|queued for background reconnection

model_watch._comment: K4: a running card whose worker's model calls fail with no tool progress (bin/model_watch.py). error_line counts each failed call once (a stall also logs Stream stale just before it, B2V-07); a stall lasts 900 s, so a 30-minute window holds at most 2: min_errors 2
